title: Algebraic local duality with completed Ext
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a nonzero commutative Noetherian local ring, let $\kappa=A/\mathfrak m$, and let $\omega\in D(A)$ be a normalized algebraic dualizing complex [def-per-algebraic-normalized-dualizing]. For an $A$-module $N$, put $\Gamma_{\mathfrak m}(N)=\{x:\mathfrak m^n x=0\text{ for some }n\geq1\}$ and $H^i_{\mathfrak m}(N)=R^i\Gamma_{\mathfrak m}(N)$ for $i\geq0$. There is an injective hull $\kappa\hookrightarrow E$: $E$ is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and every nonzero submodule of $E$ intersects the image of $\kappa$ nontrivially. For any such $E$, every finitely generated $A$-module $M$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and every integer $i\geq0$, there is an $A$-linear isomorphism $$\widehat{\operatorname{Ext}^{-i}_A(M,\omega)}\cong\operatorname{Hom}_A(H^i_{\mathfrak m}(M),E).$$ Here $\operatorname{Ext}^j_A(M,\omega)=H^jR\operatorname{Hom}_A(M[0],\omega)$ and $\widehat N=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}N/\mathfrak m^nN$ is ordinary module completion. No completeness of $A$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0AAK (lemma-special-case-local-duality), restricted to K=M[0]; Tag 08Y3 (lemma-injective-hull) for the existence of E; Tag 0955 (lemma-local-cohomology-noetherian) for derived ideal torsion rather than only the closed-support model.

from.place: Proof Step 1: dimension-normalized Verdier duality and the middle t-structure; the finite-coefficient potential-dualizing construction, via the normal-local top-residue-class input (ILO XVII Lemma 3.5.8): normality of completion and connectedness of punctured principal slices. Specific input: The bound on the closed complement of an algebraized neighborhood, and the empty-puncture dimension comparison, in the complete-local connectedness input. In the isolated-intersection bound: Tag 0DXE (lemma-cd-maximal), the top-degree nonvanishing assertion. Supporting input in Tag 0DXE: the local-duality formula in the last paragraph; the completion on Ext is retained.
